art28_clauses.subprocessor_flowdown.quote: The Processor shall impose the same data protection obligations as set out in this Agreement on every Sub-processor.

art28_clauses.subprocessor_change_notice.quote: The Processor shall inform the Controller of any intended addition or replacement of a Sub-processor at least 30 days in advance, and the Controller may object to the change within that period.
